# `toolu delivery-flow`

Deliver a task end to end, from brainstorm to a babysat PR (a Markdown-only plugin).

Owner: `plugins/delivery-flow`.

## `toolu delivery-flow`

```text
delivery-flow is a Markdown-only plugin: it has no verbs. Its one skill delivers a task end to end: brainstorm, an approved spec and plan, real-data execution, the pull request and the pr-babysit handoff.

Run it as /delivery-flow:delivery-flow in Claude Code or $delivery-flow:delivery-flow in Codex.

Usage: toolu delivery-flow [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json
          Print exactly one JSON document on stdout

  -q, --quiet
          Drop the diagnostics of a successful run

      --host <HOST>
          The host to act for, instead of the detected one

          [possible values: claude, codex, opencode, cursor, hermes]

      --config-dir <DIR>
          Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```
